description_en: Retrieves the access records of risky sensitive data on a specified date across all DataWorks workspaces under a tenant
description_zh: 获取租户下所有DataWorks工作空间指定日期中有风险的敏感数据访问记录
name: GetOpRiskData

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据量，最大值为1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The condition settings for retrieving access records. Optional parameters are as follows:
dbType: The database type.
instanceName: The instance name.
databaseName: The database name.
projectName: The project name.
clusterName: The cluster name.

Example of retrieving sensitive data access records for the abc database of the ABC instance in Hologres:
[  {"dbType":"hologres","instanceName":"ABC","databaseName":"abc"} ]

Configure the parameters based on the engine used in your business
parameters.help_zh:
获取访问记录的条件设置。可选的参数如下：
dbType：数据类型。
instanceName：实例名称。
databaseName：数据库名称。
projectName：项目名称。
clusterName：集群名称。

示例获取Hologres中ABC实例的abc数据库的敏感数据访问记录：
[  {"dbType":"hologres","instanceName":"ABC","databaseName":"abc"} ]

实际使用时，您需要根据业务使用的引擎进行配置
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The date for which to retrieve access records. Format: yyyyMMdd
parameters.help_zh: 获取访问记录的日期。格式为：yyyyMMdd
parameters.name: date

parameters.help_en:
The method used to identify the risk type. Valid values:
Manual identification.
The name of the risk rule. You can obtain the name on the Risk Identification Management page in Data Security Guard of DataWorks
parameters.help_zh:
指通过什么方式识别风险类型。取值如下：
手工识别。
风险规则名称，您可以进入DataWorks的数据保护伞，在风险识别管理页面获取
parameters.name: risk_type

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which uniquely identifies the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，一次请求的唯一标识

RiskData.description_en:
The returned information about risky sensitive data. This includes totalCount (the total number of sensitive data entries) and opRiskDatas (the list of risky data).
The opRiskDatas list includes the following fields:
sensType: The sensitivity type.
sensLevel: The sensitivity level.
opType: The operation type.
sql: The SQL statement executed for the operation.
opAccount: The account that performed the operation.
opTime: The time when the operation was performed
RiskData.description_zh:
返回的有风险的敏感数据信息。包括totalCount（敏感数据总条数）和opRiskDatas（风险数据列表）。
其中opRiskDatas（风险数据列表）包括：
sensType：敏感类型。
sensLevel：敏感级别。
opType：操作类型。
sql：操作执行的sql语句。
opAccount：执行操作的账号。
opTime：执行操作的时间
